description: Elections Commission - Declare that Gopalapillai Rasu as a Member of Porativu Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Porativu Pattu Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves electoral processes including the resignation of a member, nomination by a recognized political party, and the official declaration of a new member. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities elections.
